test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Eternal; lasting forever or indefinitely.
solution:
The correct answer is **Perpetual**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Perpetual:** continuing for a long period of time without stopping.
 
• **Eternal**: existing or continuing for ever.
 
• Thus, the **one-word substitute **for the given group of words is **Perpetual**. 

The correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Peristyle: **a row of columns surrounding a space within a building such as a court or internal garden or edging a veranda or porch.
 
• **Perplex:** make (someone) feel completely baffled.
 
• **Permissive:** having, allowing or showing a lot of freedom that many people do not approve of
